error_message: Staged Mauser C96: the hip reload was re-declared as the P38 magazine clip (rows_p12_c96.txt: coopr_mauser_c96_reload / _reload_empty -> viewmodel/pistol/reload_p38.skc) although the released game loads the C96 from the top with a stripper clip (anims_shared.txt: coopr_mauser_c96_reload -> viewmodel/coop_reload/c96_reload.skc, torso row coop_reload_c96 with the prop attach timeline 28 / 41 / 44 / 47 / 56). error_message: srvrows.py printed 90 declared changes instead of 93 with 0 FAIL when IRONSIGHT_EXTRA_PAKS (the wip overlay) was still set in the shell: 'released' rows were read through the overlay, i.e. the staged file was compared with itself
root_cause: the checker reads released files through the lane's VFS, which mounts the overlay named in that environment variable
fix: run srvrows.py with the variable unset (the committed figures - stage 115 tiks / 93 declared / 0 FAIL, ship2 9 / 0 / 0 - were); not guarded in the code yet
